task.title: Running Your First Script
task.shortdesc: Create a simple C# script, attach it to a GameObject, and confirm it runs inside the Unity Editor.

prereq.p: Complete Installing Unity and Connecting It to Visual Studio before starting this task.

step.cmd: In the Unity Project window, right-click and select Create > C# Script.
Double-click the script to open it in Visual Studio.
Replace the default Start() method with a line that logs a message, then save the file.
Drag the script from the Project window onto any GameObject in the Hierarchy window.
step.stepresult: The script now appears as a component on that GameObject.

step.cmd: Select Play in the Unity toolbar.
step.stepresult: The message appears in the Unity Console window, confirming the script executed successfully.

result.p: You have confirmed that Unity and Visual Studio are correctly linked and that scripts written in Visual Studio run as expected inside the Unity Editor.
